PPP MEDSAMPLE02
Occupational English Test

WRITING SUB-TEST: MEDICINE
SAMPLE RESPONSE: LETTER OF REFERRAL




Dr Barbara Jones
Dietician
Brightford General Hospital
Brightford



8 June 2018



Dear Dr Jones

Re: Miss Rosemary Smith, DOB: 15/2/04

Thank you for seeing Rosemary McQueen, recently diagnosed with celiac disease. I would be grateful if you could
instruct her and her parents about the management of her gluten-free diet.

Rosemary is 15 years old and suffers intermittently from asthma for which she uses Albuterol. Her mother has type
2 diabetes and her father has Crohn’s disease. Rosemary was transferred to the Paediatric unit from the Emergency
Department after admission on 6 August with persistent diarrhoea, ‘greasy’ stools and abdominal pain. She also
reported considerable weight loss (2.5kg in the past 2 weeks) and easy bruising. Antitissue transglutaminase,
Antiendomysial and Antigliadin tests conducted on 6/6/18 were positive. A small-bowel biopsy revealed flattened
intestinal villi and lymphocyte infiltration but excluded bowel wall lymphoma.

Rosemary will continue medication with ferrous sulphate for six months and is due to have antibody titres in six weeks’
time, when CBC and calcium levels will also be checked.

As you will appreciate, Rosemary’s family already have conditions which necessitate particular attention to diet, so it is
important that dietary amendments for Rosemary do not impact too much on existing restrictions for some members of
her family.

Please contact me if I can be of any more assistance.

Yours sincerely,




Doctor
